medieval_abbasid_baghdad.aesthetic: Round City of Baghdad along the Tigris, grand libraries with thousands of leather-bound scrolls, mosaic courtyards, fountain sprays, silk and amber perfume bazaars, night lute songs.
medieval_abbasid_baghdad.tech: Paper mills, astrolabes, algebraic treatises, translation of Greek/Persian/Indian scientific texts, surgical tools, water clocks.
medieval_abbasid_baghdad.social_codes: Scholarly prestige and debate, Bayt al-Hikma patron honor, Harun al-Rashid court grandeur, poetic love contests, cosmopolitan Islamic etiquette.

medieval_mamluk_egypt.name: ⚔️ Mamluk Sultanate of Cairo (c. 1250 – 1517 CE)
medieval_mamluk_egypt.aesthetic: Cairo Citadel stone towers, carved stone minarets with intricate lace stonework, striped ablaq masonry, heavy steel scimitars, damascene enameled glass lamps, Nile spice docks.
medieval_mamluk_egypt.tech: Superior equestrian horsemanship (furusiyya), heavy composite bow archery, enameled mosque glass, metal inlay craft.
medieval_mamluk_egypt.social_codes: Mamluk military slave-soldier meritocracy, amir rivalries and sudden palace assassinations, lavish architectural waqf endowments, fierce warrior code.

medieval_seljuk_anatolia.name: 🌙 Seljuk Sultanate of Rum (c. 1077 – 1307 CE)
medieval_seljuk_anatolia.aesthetic: Monolithic stone caravanserai (han) fortresses along the Silk Road, turquoise tiled madrasas of Konya, whirling dervish lodges, wool kilim rugs, mountain steppe passes.
medieval_seljuk_anatolia.tech: Monumental stone masonry with stalactite portals, horse archery, ceramic glaze chemistry, trade network caravanserai systems.
medieval_seljuk_anatolia.social_codes: Turco-Persian court synthesis, Sufi mystical devotion of Rumi, frontier ghazi warrior ethos, caravan guest protection laws.

medieval_kievan_rus.name: 🛡️ Kievan Rus & The Golden Gate (c. 988 – 1240 CE)
medieval_kievan_rus.aesthetic: Golden onion domes of St. Sophia, massive oak timber kremlins along the Dnieper, fur-trimmed velvet capes, silver temple rings woven into braids, birch forests, mead horns.
medieval_kievan_rus.tech: River longboat portage, iron ring armor, icon painting on linden wood, monumental timber architecture, Cyrillic scriptoria.
medieval_kievan_rus.social_codes: Grand Prince court druzhina warrior retinue loyalty, veche town assembly debates, Pravda Russkaya legal codes, Orthodox Christian baptism zeal.

medieval_novgorod_republic.name: 📜 Novgorod Merchant Republic (c. 1136 – 1478 CE)
medieval_novgorod_republic.aesthetic: Cobblestone squares with ringing veche bells, Volkhov river wharves stacked with sables and walrus ivory, birch-bark love letters, whitewashed stone churches, fur mittens.
medieval_novgorod_republic.tech: Birch bark literacy writing styluses, wooden pavement engineering, ice sledge transport, fur grading, river navigation.
medieval_novgorod_republic.social_codes: Veche republican citizen democracy, boyar merchant council disputes, hired prince military commanders (Alexander Nevsky), high female literacy and business autonomy.

medieval_mongol_empire.name: 🏹 Mongol Empire & Steppe Khanates (c. 1206 – 1368 CE)
medieval_mongol_empire.aesthetic: Felt yurts (ger) on vast sea of grassland, boiling mares' milk (airag), boqta headdresses towering with peacock feathers, boiled leather lamellar armor, composite reflex bows.
medieval_mongol_empire.tech: Horn-and-sinew composite bows, horse courier postal system (Yam), siege engineers recruited from across Eurasia, silver paiza passport tokens.
medieval_mongol_empire.social_codes: Yassa law of Genghis Khan, absolute clan fealty, meritocratic promotion over aristocratic birth, female khatun governance of the camp while men campaigned.

medieval_japan_heian.name: 👘 Heian Period Japan — Imperial Kyoto Court (c. 794 – 1185 CE)
medieval_japan_heian.aesthetic: Twelve-layer silk robes (junihitoe), floor-length glossy black hair, lacquered wooden screens, cherry blossoms reflected in palace ponds, scented letter paper, waka poetry.
medieval_japan_heian.tech: Kana phonetic script development, wooden post-and-beam palace architecture (shinden-zukuri), natural plant fabric dyeing, lacquering.
medieval_japan_heian.social_codes: Obsession with aesthetic taste (mono no aware), indirect poetic courtship through screen partitions, Fujiwara regent clan dominance, aversion to blood/impurity.
titles: The Waka Poetess Behind the Screen

medieval_japan_kamakura.name: ⚔️ Kamakura Shogunate & Early Samurai (c. 1185 – 1333 CE)
medieval_japan_kamakura.aesthetic: Great Bronze Buddha of Kamakura under ocean winds, boxy o-yoroi laced armor, horseback archery targets (yabusame), Zen rock gardens, austere cedar halls.
medieval_japan_kamakura.tech: Folded tamahagane steel forging, mounted archery bows (yumi), water-powered rice pounders, Zen Buddhist temple engineering.
medieval_japan_kamakura.social_codes: Early warrior code of the bow and horse (kyuba no michi), personal lord-vassal loyalty, Spartan frugality over Kyoto court luxury, Hojo clan regent governance.

medieval_japan_sengoku.name: 🌸 Sengoku Jidai — Warring States Japan (c. 1467 – 1600 CE)
medieval_japan_sengoku.aesthetic: Mountain fortresses burning against pine trees, curved castle keeps with stone bases, black-lacquered armor laced with scarlet silk, ashigaru spear walls, tea ceremony bowls.
medieval_japan_sengoku.tech: Tanegashima matchlock guns, castle stone wall engineering, iron bullet-resistant breastplates, folding steel swords, smoke signaling.
medieval_japan_sengoku.social_codes: Gekokujo (the low overthrowing the high), political hostage marriages, tea ceremony quiet before battle, lethal ninja espionage, absolute family survival.

medieval_china_song.name: 🍵 Song Dynasty China — Porcelain & Tea (c. 960 – 1279 CE)
medieval_china_song.aesthetic: Misty mountain watercolor ink landscapes, jade-green celadon teacups, bustling canal bridges of Kaifeng, silk robes with bamboo embroidery, scholar study desks with ink-stones.
medieval_china_song.tech: Moveable type printing, gunpowder formulas, magnetic mariner's compass, multi-stage water clocks, blast furnace steel, paper bank notes.
medieval_china_song.social_codes: Civil scholar-bureaucracy over military generals, Neo-Confucian moral discipline, imperial examination mastery, refined tea tasting and poetry competitions.

medieval_china_ming.name: 🏯 Early Ming Dynasty & The Forbidden City (c. 1368 – 1500 CE)
medieval_china_ming.aesthetic: Red palace walls of the newly built Forbidden City, yellow glazed roof tiles, cobalt blue-and-white porcelain vases, silk robes with dragon roundels, seven treasure fleets.
medieval_china_ming.tech: Treasure fleet ocean caravels of Zheng He, Great Wall brick reinforcement, cobalt blue porcelain glazes, bronze artillery cannons.
medieval_china_ming.social_codes: Restoration of Han Chinese rule, Emperor Yongle absolute court discipline, secret police Brocade Guard (Jinyiwei) surveillance, palace eunuch bureaucracy.

medieval_korea_goryeo.name: 🏺 Goryeo Dynasty Korea & Lotus Celadon (c. 918 – 1392 CE)
medieval_korea_goryeo.aesthetic: Exquisite inlaid jade celadon pottery, Buddhist mountain monasteries, gold-painted silk sutras, flowing high-waisted hanbok with wide sleeves, pine-scented mountain courtyards.
medieval_korea_goryeo.tech: Movable metal type printing (pre-Gutenberg Jikji), intricate inlaid celadon (sanggam), Tripitaka Koreana 80,000 woodblock carvings.
medieval_korea_goryeo.social_codes: State-sponsored Buddhist court rituals, powerful aristocratic clans, female property inheritance and remarriage freedom, military regime struggles.

medieval_korea_joseon.name: 📜 Early Joseon Dynasty & Hangul Dawn (c. 1392 – 1500 CE)
medieval_korea_joseon.aesthetic: Clean wooden architecture of Gyeongbokgung Palace, white porcelain jars, scholar horsehair hats (gat), newly promulgated Hangul alphabet characters, scholarly study courtyards.
medieval_korea_joseon.tech: Rain gauges (cheugugi), water clocks, sundials, Hangul phonetic alphabet creation by King Sejong, cast bronze printing type.
medieval_korea_joseon.social_codes: Strict Neo-Confucian ancestral propriety, separation of men and women's quarters (sarangbang and anbang), yangban noble family duty, filial piety.

medieval_india_delhi_sultanate.name: 🕌 Delhi Sultanate & Indo-Islamic Courts (c. 1206 – 1526 CE)
medieval_india_delhi_sultanate.aesthetic: Red sandstone Qutb Minar, lattice stone jali screens, scented rosewater fountains, heavy gold zardozi embroidered silks, jewel-hilted talwar swords, mango groves.
medieval_india_delhi_sultanate.tech: Persian wheel irrigation, spinning wheel textile technology, papermaking, dome and arch masonry, wootz crucible steel.
medieval_india_delhi_sultanate.social_codes: Turco-Afghan court nobility, Sufi musical qawwali traditions, purdah court seclusion protocols, fierce warrior honor, lavish royal durbars.

medieval_india_chola.name: 🛕 Imperial Chola Empire & Maritime South (c. 848 – 1279 CE)
medieval_india_chola.aesthetic: Granite Brihadisvara Temple soaring into the sky, lost-wax bronze sculptures of dancing Shiva, fragrant jasmine garlands, temple dancer silk saris, ocean armada sails.
medieval_india_chola.tech: Lost-wax bronze casting perfection, mammoth granite dry-masonry construction, oceanic naval navigation across Bay of Bengal, agricultural tank irrigation.
medieval_india_chola.social_codes: Temple-centered village self-governance (sabhas), royal devadasis respected artistic status, naval trade guild dominance, Shaivite devotional poetry.
titles: The Bay of Bengal Naval Admiral's Wife

medieval_mali_empire.name: 👑 Mali Empire & Golden Timbuktu (c. 1235 – 1400 CE)
medieval_mali_empire.aesthetic: Sun-baked earth mosque of Djinguereber, camel caravans laden with rock salt and pure gold dust, indigo-dyed cotton boubous, gold filigree necklaces, Niger river canoes.
medieval_mali_empire.tech: Sudano-Sahelian earthen architecture, gold metallurgy, trans-Saharan caravan logistics, astronomical and legal manuscript libraries of Timbuktu.
medieval_mali_empire.social_codes: Mansa Musa royal generosity, griot oral historian caste preservation of epics (Sundiata), Islamic scholarship honors, matrilineal lineage respect in trade.
titles: The Indigo Dyer Queen of Djenne

medieval_aztec_tenochtitlan.name: 🦅 Aztec Empire — Tenochtitlan & The Sun (c. 1325 – 1521 CE)
medieval_aztec_tenochtitlan.aesthetic: Glistening island city of Tenochtitlan on Lake Texcoco, great stone pyramid Templo Mayor, iridescent quetzal feather headdresses, obsidian razor-blades, floating chinampa gardens.
medieval_aztec_tenochtitlan.tech: Floating island agriculture (chinampas), obsidian stoneworking, causeway dyke engineering, pictographic bark paper codices, herbal pharmacology.
medieval_aztec_tenochtitlan.social_codes: Flowery war warrior status (Eagle and Jaguar knights), solar cosmic debt sacrifice, calmecac noble schools, strict calm moral household discipline.

medieval_inca_andes.name: ☀️ Inca Empire — Cusco & The Sun Road (c. 1438 – 1532 CE)
medieval_inca_andes.aesthetic: Seamless mortarless stone palaces of Cusco, emerald mountain agricultural terraces hanging in cloud mist, llama caravans, brightly dyed alpaca wool tunics, golden solar discs.
medieval_inca_andes.tech: Seismic-resistant polygonal stone masonry, suspension rope bridges, quipu knotted-string accounting, freeze-dried potato storage (chuno), paved mountain road network.
medieval_inca_andes.social_codes: Mita communal labor reciprocity, Sapa Inca divine solar descent, Chosen Women (Acllacuna) sacred weaving, communal ayllu loyalty.
titles: The Chosen Woman of the Sun (Aclla)

italian_renaissance.name: 🎨 Italian Renaissance (c. 1450 – 1550 CE)
italian_renaissance.aesthetic: Frescoed Florence palazzos, Venetian grand canals with velvet gondolas, pearls woven in golden braids, slashed silk doublets, lute serenades, masquerade half-masks.
italian_renaissance.tech: Oil painting mastery, perspective geometry, mechanical clock towers, movable type printing press, blast furnaces, navigational astrolabes.
italian_renaissance.social_codes: Medici merchant prince rivalry, humanist academy debates, illicit palazzo trysts, poisonous court rivalries, lavish dowry arrangements.

tudor_elizabethan.name: 👑 Tudor & Elizabethan England (c. 1485 – 1603 CE)
tudor_elizabethan.aesthetic: Half-timbered manor houses, stiff starched lace ruffs, velvet farthingales encrusted with pearls, wax-sealed royal warrants, Globe theatre playhouses, falconry lawns.
tudor_elizabethan.tech: Early printed books, cast iron cannons, rapiers, galleon warships, mechanical pocket dials, alchemy workshops.
tudor_elizabethan.social_codes: Royal court patronage, constant fear of the Tower of London treason, Protestant-Catholic religious espionage, witty sonnet courtship.

golden_age_of_sail.name: ⚓ Golden Age of Piracy & Sail (c. 1650 – 1730 CE)
golden_age_of_sail.aesthetic: Three-masted wooden frigates pitching in squalls, canvas sails, tarred rigging, flintlock pistols, brass spyglasses, Caribbean port taverns, sea-chest maps.
golden_age_of_sail.tech: Flintlock muskets & cutlasses, naval broadside cannons, quadrant & sextant navigation, cooperage, tallow candles.
golden_age_of_sail.social_codes: Shipboard Pirate Code democracy, colonial governor despotism, admiralty court hangings, privateer letters of marque, naval flogging discipline.

baroque_enlightenment.name: 🕯️ Enlightenment & Versailles Baroque (c. 1715 – 1789 CE)
baroque_enlightenment.aesthetic: Hall of Mirrors Versailles splendor, powdered towering periwigs, pastel silk pannier gowns, scented beauty patches, dueling rapiers, harpsichord salon nocturnes.
baroque_enlightenment.tech: Seed drills, hot air balloons, mercury thermometers, flintlock dueling pistols, cast glass mirrors, porcelain manufactories.
baroque_enlightenment.social_codes: Philosophical salon salons of Voltaire, libertine seduction games, strict royal lever/coucher court rituals, duels at dawn for honor.

regency_napoleonic.name: 🎩 Regency & Napoleonic Era (c. 1795 – 1837 CE)
regency_napoleonic.aesthetic: Empire-waist muslin gowns with ribbons, brass-buttoned tailcoats with neckcloth cravats, horse-drawn curricles, Mayfair ballrooms, pianofortes, letter seal wax.
regency_napoleonic.tech: Steam pumping engines, early gas lighting in cities, semaphore telegraph towers, lithography, percussion caps.
regency_napoleonic.social_codes: The London 'Season' marriage market, Almack's ball exclusivity, strict chaperone rules, country estate entails, decorous yet biting gossip.
titles: The Wallflower with a Sharp Tongue

victorian_era.name: 🕰️ Victorian Era — Gaslamp & Industrial (c. 1837 – 1901 CE)
victorian_era.aesthetic: Gaslamp cobblestone streets, dense yellow pea-soup fog, horse-drawn hansom cabs, corset stays and heavy crinolines, velvet parlors, ticking pocket watches, mourning jewelry.
victorian_era.tech: Steam railways, electric telegraph, daguerreotype photography, incandescent light bulbs, sewing machines, transatlantic telegraph cables.
victorian_era.social_codes: Rigid social propriety, angel-in-the-house domestic expectations, formal calling cards, unyielding chaperone protocols, scandalous unspoken desires.

wild_west_frontier.name: 🏜️ American Wild West & Frontier (c. 1860 – 1895 CE)
wild_west_frontier.aesthetic: Dusty boomtown streets, wooden boardwalks, swinging saloon doors, Colt .45 Peacemaker revolvers, leather boots, oil lanterns, timber cabins, steam locomotive whistles.
wild_west_frontier.tech: Repeating Winchester rifles, telegraph poles, transcontinental railroad, barbed wire, mechanical windmills, tin-type photos.
wild_west_frontier.social_codes: Frontier self-reliance, vigilante sheriff law, saloon card table etiquette, mail-order bride arrangements, stubborn homesteader solidarity.

belle_epoque_edwardian.name: 🥂 Belle Époque & Edwardian Era (c. 1890 – 1914 CE)
belle_epoque_edwardian.aesthetic: Art Nouveau sinuous ironwork, Parisian grand boulevards, sweeping feather hats, crystal champagne flutes, gramophone waltzes, Grand Tour luxury steamships.
belle_epoque_edwardian.tech: Early automobiles, gramophone records, silent cinema, electric trams, ocean liners (Titanic era), early wireless radio.
belle_epoque_edwardian.social_codes: Decadent high society summer house parties, Bohemian Montmartre artist salons, early suffragette sparks, opulent aristocratic twilight.

roaring_twenties.name: 🎷 Roaring Twenties & Jazz Age (1920 – 1929 CE)
roaring_twenties.aesthetic: Art Deco chrome and black lacquer, underground speakeasy eye-slots, fringed flapper dresses, jazz trumpets, cigarette holders, sleek Duesenbergs and Packards.
roaring_twenties.tech: Commercial radio broadcasting, sound cinema (talkies), mass-produced automobiles (Ford Model T), consumer refrigerators, electric phonographs.
roaring_twenties.social_codes: Prohibition law defiance, bootleg mob syndicates, fast money and stock speculation, bobbed hair female rebellion, Charleston dancing abandon.

noir_interwar_1940s.name: 🕵️ 1940s Film Noir & Wartime (1939 – 1949 CE)
noir_interwar_1940s.aesthetic: Rain-slicked city pavement under neon signs, venetian blind shadows on frosted glass, trench coats and tilted fedoras, heavy Bakelite rotary phones, smoke rings, swing bands.
noir_interwar_1940s.tech: Radar, jet engines, vacuum-tube computers (ENIAC), shortwave radio, nylon stockings, submachine guns.
noir_interwar_1940s.social_codes: Hardboiled post-war cynicism, wartime rationing solidarity, femme fatale double-crosses, underworld marker debts, dry sardonic repartee.

fifties_midcentury.name: 📻 1950s Mid-Century & Atomic Age (1950 – 1959 CE)
fifties_midcentury.aesthetic: Chrome and neon diners, pastel convertibles with tailfins, vinyl jukeboxes, atomic boomerang patterns, poodle skirts, black and white TV sets, white picket fences.
fifties_midcentury.tech: Transistor radios, color television, commercial jetliners, polio vaccine, microwave ovens, backyard bomb shelters.
fifties_midcentury.social_codes: Suburban domestic perfectionism, rigid traditional gender roles, Cold War nuclear drills, hidden marital discontent, early rock and roll rebellion.
titles: The Madison Avenue Ad Agency Girl

seventies_coldwar.name: 📼 1960s–70s Cold War Espionage & Disco (1965 – 1979 CE)
seventies_coldwar.aesthetic: Analog reel-to-reel audio tape, smoke-fogged embassy corridors, shag carpets, corduroy jackets with wide collars, discotheque mirror balls, muscle cars, rotary phones.
seventies_coldwar.tech: Cassette tapes, Concorde supersonic flight, microprocessors, lunar landers, 8-track players, 35mm film cameras.
seventies_coldwar.social_codes: Cold War KGB/CIA paranoia, double-agent loyalties, counterculture revolution, cynical realpolitik, women's liberation movement.

eighties_retro.name: 🕹️ 1980s Neon Retro & Cassette Futurism (1980 – 1989 CE)
eighties_retro.aesthetic: Magenta and electric cyan neon, cassette Walkmans, CRT arcade cabinets, synthesizer basslines, shoulder-padded blazers, mall food courts, VHS video grain.
eighties_retro.tech: Personal computers (Apple II, Commodore 64), Sony Walkman, VHS camcorders, cellular car phones, arcade machines, MIDI synths.
eighties_retro.social_codes: Wall Street consumerist ambition, yuppie status fitness craze, MTV pop stardom culture, Cold War twilight, synthwave escapism.

nineties_grunge_y2k.name: 💾 1990s Grunge & Pre-Y2K Dawn (1990 – 1999 CE)
nineties_grunge_y2k.aesthetic: Tied flannel shirts, Doc Martens boots, screeching 56k dial-up modems, CRT beige towers, industrial warehouse raves, disposable cameras, CD jewel cases, coffeehouse poetry.
nineties_grunge_y2k.tech: World Wide Web (dial-up), pager beepers, CD-ROMs, floppy disks, Game Boy, early digital cameras, chatrooms (IRC/AOL).
nineties_grunge_y2k.social_codes: Gen-X anti-corporate cynicism, indie rebellion, cyber-utopian optimism vs Y2K panic, riot grrrl female empowerment, grunge aesthetics.

medieval_viking_scandinavia.name: 🛡️ Viking Age Scandinavia & Norse Jarls (c. 793 – 1066 CE)
medieval_viking_scandinavia.aesthetic: Carved dragon-prow longships cutting through foggy fjords, smoky turf longhouses lit by peat fires, woven wool cloaks clasped with silver brooches, runestones carved in granite, mead horns, roaring hearths.
medieval_viking_scandinavia.tech: Clinker-built wooden longships, pattern-welded iron swords, round wooden shields with iron bosses, bearded battle-axes, riveted chainmail, bone combs, runic script. No plate armor, no crossbows, no parchment codices.
medieval_viking_scandinavia.social_codes: Thing assemblies of freemen, blood-feuds resolved by weregild, strict hospitality laws, shieldmaiden honor, loyalty to the Jarl, sworn oaths on silver arm-rings.
titles: The Völva Seeress of the Hearth

medieval_wales_marches.name: 🏹 Medieval Wales & The Marcher Lordships (c. 1066 – 1400 CE)
medieval_wales_marches.aesthetic: Mist-shrouded Snowdonia peaks, slate-roofed stone keeps, deep oak valleys, Welsh harpists playing in mountain halls, rain-lashed border march castles, yew-wood war bows.
medieval_wales_marches.tech: Famous Welsh yew longbows, chainmail hauberks, spears, short hunting swords, mountain fortresses (castell), horse-breeding. No plate armor, no cannons.
medieval_wales_marches.social_codes: Cyfraith Hywel (Welsh legal codes), passionate bardic praise and satires, fierce clan independence, defiance of Norman Marcher Barons.

medieval_swiss_confederacy.name: 🏔️ Old Swiss Confederacy & Mountain Cantons (c. 1291 – 1500 CE)
medieval_swiss_confederacy.aesthetic: Snow-capped Alpine valleys, rugged timber chalets, stone mountain passes (St. Gotthard), ringing cowbells, roaring torrents, heavy iron-pointed pikes and halberds.
medieval_swiss_confederacy.tech: Halberds, 18-foot infantry pikes, crossbows, iron kettle-hat helmets, leather jacks, mountain fortifications. Early firearms appearing only at the very end.
medieval_swiss_confederacy.social_codes: Egalitarian cantonal oath-fraternities (Eidgenossenschaft), fierce collective defense against Habsburg imperial nobility, stubborn communal self-governance.

medieval_hungary_corvinus.name: 🦅 Kingdom of Hungary & The Black Army (c. 1000 – 1490 CE)
medieval_hungary_corvinus.aesthetic: Gothic Buda Castle perched above the Danube, Carpathian mountain strongholds, Renaissance courtiers mixing with nomadic steppe horsemen, heavy silk banners with the raven of Corvinus.
medieval_hungary_corvinus.tech: Crossbows, early matchlock arquebuses of the Black Army (Fekete Sereg), plate armor, heavy hussar lances, Danube river barges, stone bastions.
medieval_hungary_corvinus.social_codes: Saint Stephen's crown loyalty, proud Hungarian noble diets (Régiség), chivalric crusader duty defending Christendom against eastern expansion.

medieval_portugal_reconquista.name: ⚓ Medieval Kingdom of Portugal & Order of Avis (c. 1139 – 1415 CE)
medieval_portugal_reconquista.aesthetic: Atlantic ocean winds whipping against battlements of Guimarães and Sintra, olive groves, monastic convents of Tomar, azulejo tile dawn, pine forests supplying future ship timber.
medieval_portugal_reconquista.tech: Iron swords, crossbows, mail hauberks, coastal cogs and early lateen caravels, astrolabes, portolan charts.
medieval_portugal_reconquista.social_codes: Knighthood of Avis and Christ, reconquista crusader vows, maritime exploration fervor, seafaring independence from Castilian crowns.

medieval_ethiopia_solomonic.name: 👑 Solomonic Ethiopian Empire & Lalibela (c. 1270 – 1550 CE)
medieval_ethiopia_solomonic.aesthetic: Monolithic rock-hewn churches of Lalibela carved into volcanic tuff, mountain amba fortress plateaus, illuminated Ge'ez gospel parchments, brass ceremonial crosses, incense burners.
medieval_ethiopia_solomonic.tech: Iron spearheads, curved shotel swords, leather hide shields, volcanic stone masonry, terraced mountain irrigation. No gunpowder, no printing.
medieval_ethiopia_solomonic.social_codes: Kebra Nagast imperial lineage, devotion to the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, strict royal court protocol of the travelling royal camp (katama).

medieval_swahili_kilwa.name: 💎 Swahili Coast & Kilwa Sultanate (c. 1000 – 1500 CE)
medieval_swahili_kilwa.aesthetic: Multi-story coral rag stone palaces with vaulted domes, Indian Ocean turquoise waters, monsoon trade dhows with billowing triangular sails, fine porcelain imported from China, cloves and ambergris.
medieval_swahili_kilwa.tech: Coral stone lime architecture, oceanic sewn dhows, ironworking, gold minting (Kilwa dinars), cotton weaving.
medieval_swahili_kilwa.social_codes: Cosmopolitan maritime merchant aristocracy, Islamic legal jurisprudence (Qadi courts), hospitality for Indian Ocean traders from Arabia, Persia, and India.

medieval_khmer_angkor.name: 🛕 Khmer Empire & Angkor Wat (c. 802 – 1431 CE)
medieval_khmer_angkor.aesthetic: Colossal smiling stone faces of the Bayon, massive moat-encircled sandstone temples of Angkor Wat, shimmering baray water reservoirs, golden royal barge flotillas, lotus pools.
medieval_khmer_angkor.tech: Monumental sandstone block masonry without mortar, hydraulic canal engineering, bronze casting, war elephant howdahs, iron-tipped spears and bows.
medieval_khmer_angkor.social_codes: Devaraja (God-King) sacred majesty, Hindu-Buddhist syncretic court rituals, royal apsara dancers, reverence for ancestral water engineering.

medieval_majapahit.name: ⛵ Majapahit Empire & Spice Seas (c. 1293 – 1527 CE)
medieval_majapahit.aesthetic: Red-brick candi gateways rising out of tropical Java, waving wavy-bladed keris daggers, gamelan bronze chimes ringing across court courtyards, fleets of jong warships carrying nutmeg and cloves.
medieval_majapahit.tech: Giant wooden ocean-going jong vessels, bronze swivel cannons (cetbang), Damascus-style pamor keris forging, terracotta sculpture, irrigated rice terraces.
medieval_majapahit.social_codes: Royal court hierarchy of Trowulan, oath of unity (Sumpah Palapa), maritime trade tribute, Hindu-Javanese court etiquette.

medieval_burma_pagan.name: 🛕 Pagan Kingdom & The Plains of Bagan (c. 1044 – 1287 CE)
medieval_burma_pagan.aesthetic: Vast dry plains of Bagan studded with over ten thousand red-brick pagodas and gilded spires, saffron-robed Theravada monks chanting, Ayeyarwady river teak boats, lacquerware vessels.
medieval_burma_pagan.tech: Brick arch and vault temple engineering, bronze casting of monumental Buddha statues, palm-leaf manuscript transcription, war elephants.
medieval_burma_pagan.social_codes: Merit-making through pagoda construction, Theravada Buddhist devotion, royal patronage of monastic sanghas, courtly Burmese protocol.

antiquity_minoan_mycenaean.name: 🏺 Minoan Crete & Bronze Age Greece (c. 1900 – 1100 BCE)
antiquity_minoan_mycenaean.aesthetic: Multi-story labyrinthine palace of Knossos, vivid frescoes of dolphins and acrobatic bull-leaping, cyclopean stone lion gates of Mycenae, gold burial masks, Aegean olive breezes.
antiquity_minoan_mycenaean.tech: Cast bronze weapons, boar-tusk helmets, clay tablets in Linear A & Linear B, potter's wheels, copper and tin trade networks. No iron.
antiquity_minoan_mycenaean.social_codes: Matriarchal snake goddess reverence, palatial redistributive economy, heroic wanax kingship, maritime Aegean trade leagues.

antiquity_carthage.name: ⚓ Carthaginian Maritime Republic & Punic Wars (c. 814 – 146 BCE)
antiquity_carthage.aesthetic: Circular military harbor (Kothon) crowded with warships, white-washed Phoenician limestone towers, purple Tyrian dyed robes, merchant warehouses piled with silver and tin, Mediterranean sun.
antiquity_carthage.tech: Advanced prefabricated quinqueremes and triremes, iron weaponry, catapults, Numidian cavalry tactics, war elephants, navigational chart lore.
antiquity_carthage.social_codes: Oligarchic Senate and Council of 104, merchant aristocracy dominance, fierce rivalry with Rome, devotion to Tanit and Ba'al Hammon.

renaissance_safavid_isfahan.name: 🕌 Safavid Persian Empire & Golden Isfahan (c. 1501 – 1722 CE)
renaissance_safavid_isfahan.aesthetic: Breathtaking turquoise and cobalt mosaic tilework of Naqsh-e Jahan square, Grand Bazaar covered arched walkways, Persian miniature paintings of rose gardens and nightingales, silk carpets.
renaissance_safavid_isfahan.tech: Matchlock firearms, fine damascus wootz steel shamshir blades, astrolabes, sophisticated dome architecture, silk weaving looms.
renaissance_safavid_isfahan.social_codes: Shah's absolute divine-monarchical court, Qizilbash warrior chivalry, poetic high Persian court etiquette, patron-artist salons.

renaissance_mughal_empire.name: 🦚 Mughal Empire & The Peacock Throne (c. 1526 – 1707 CE)
renaissance_mughal_empire.aesthetic: Red sandstone bastions of Agra and Delhi, white marble domes inlaid with semi-precious lapis and jade (pietra dura), scented rosewater fountains, zardozi gold-embroidered velvet robes.
renaissance_mughal_empire.tech: Composite bows, matchlock muskets, heavy siege cannons, wootz steel talwar swords, astronomical observatories, fine paper illuminated manuscripts.
renaissance_mughal_empire.social_codes: Darbar imperial audience protocols, Mansabdari noble military ranking, exquisite Persian-Hindustani poetry recitations, zenana court life.

renaissance_ottoman_porte.name: 🌙 Ottoman Empire — Suleiman & The Sublime Porte (c. 1520 – 1566 CE)
renaissance_ottoman_porte.aesthetic: Domes and minarets of the Süleymaniye Mosque overlooking the Bosphorus, tiled courtyards of Topkapi Palace, Divan council chambers behind gilded grilles, Turkish coffee and iznik ceramics.
renaissance_ottoman_porte.tech: Giant bronze siege bombards, Janissary matchlock muskets, composite recurve bows, Damascus kilij scimitars, naval galleys of Barbarossa.
renaissance_ottoman_porte.social_codes: Kanun imperial legal order under Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent, Janissary corps discipline, Imperial Harem influence, Grand Vizier governance.

enlightenment_scottish.name: 📚 Scottish Enlightenment & Edinburgh Closes (c. 1740 – 1800 CE)
enlightenment_scottish.aesthetic: High tenement closes and steep wynds of Old Town Edinburgh, smoky tavern debate societies, leather-bound moral philosophy treatises, pewter tankards of ale, wool tailcoats and cravats.
enlightenment_scottish.tech: Early steam pump models, printing presses, surveying theodolites, microscope lenses, medical dissection theaters.
enlightenment_scottish.social_codes: Passion for debate in the Select Society, moral sentiment and reason (Hume, Adam Smith), clash between Presbyterian tradition and modern science.

victorian_meiji_japan.name: 🚂 Meiji Restoration & Bakumatsu Japan (c. 1868 – 1912 CE)
victorian_meiji_japan.aesthetic: Gas lamps illuminating Tokyo brick avenues, Western wool frock coats worn over silk haori, steam locomotives rattling alongside rickshaws, cherry blossom petals falling on iron rails.
victorian_meiji_japan.tech: Telegraph lines, steam trains, modern bolt-action rifles, print newspapers, industrial textile factories, photography.
victorian_meiji_japan.social_codes: Rapid modernization under the Meiji Emperor, abolition of samurai class privileges, struggle between ancient bushido honor and Westernization.

victorian_tsarist_russia.name: ❄️ Late Imperial Russia & St. Petersburg Romanovs (c. 1860 – 1914 CE)
victorian_tsarist_russia.aesthetic: Gilded grand ballrooms of the Winter Palace, snow-choked Nevsky Prospekt traversed by horse-drawn troikas, Fabergé enameled imperial eggs, heavy sable fur stoles, French champagne.
victorian_tsarist_russia.tech: Trans-Siberian Railway construction, telegraphs, ironclad warships, electric lighting in aristocratic palaces, industrial factories along the Neva.
victorian_tsarist_russia.social_codes: Autocratic Tsarist court etiquette, French spoken in high society, peasant emancipation tensions, rising underground revolutionary salons.

twenties_weimar_berlin.name: 🎷 Weimar Republic & Berlin Cabaret (1919 – 1933 CE)
twenties_weimar_berlin.aesthetic: Smoky subterranean cabaret clubs with spotlight beams, avant-garde Bauhaus design, decadent nightlife, jazz trumpets, bobbed flapper haircuts, monochrome expressionist cinema posters.
twenties_weimar_berlin.tech: Electric tramways, rotary telephones, cinema sound recording, radio broadcasting, modern skyscrapers, subways.
twenties_weimar_berlin.social_codes: Unprecedented artistic and personal freedom, disillusionment with post-WWI order, hyperinflation turbulence, avant-garde expressionism.
